title: Evaluation and composition of normalized adjunction mates
statement:
Let F:X→Y, G:Y→Z, H:X→Z be left adjoint to U,V,W, respectively, and let L1:A→B, L2:B→C, L3:A→C be left adjoint to R1,R2,R3. Fix right comparison isomorphisms δe:V⋅U≅W and δs:R2⋅R1≅R3, evaluation functors Gx:X→A, Gy:Y→B, Gz:Z→C, and right squares γ1:U⋅Gx→Gy⋅R1, γ2:V⋅Gy→Gz⋅R2, γ3:W⋅Gx→Gz⋅R3. Suppose evaluation isomorphisms ν1:F⋅Gy≅Gx⋅L1, ν2:G⋅Gz≅Gy⋅L2, ν3:H⋅Gz≅Gx⋅L3 intertwine every Hom transpose with the respective right square. If Gx(δe)γ3=γ1(V−)R1(γ2)δs, then Gz of the canonical adjoint-uniqueness compositor followed by ν3 equals ν2 followed by L2(ν1) and the canonical scalar compositor.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
variable {X Y Z A B C : Type*}
  [Category X] [Category Y] [Category Z] [Category A] [Category B] [Category C]
  {F : X ⥤ Y} {U : Y ⥤ X} {G : Y ⥤ Z} {V : Z ⥤ Y} {H : X ⥤ Z} {W : Z ⥤ X}
  {Gx : X ⥤ A} {Gy : Y ⥤ B} {Gz : Z ⥤ C}
  {L₁ : A ⥤ B} {R₁ : B ⥤ A} {L₂ : B ⥤ C} {R₂ : C ⥤ B}
  {L₃ : A ⥤ C} {R₃ : C ⥤ A}
theorem adjunctionEvaluation_composition
    (af : F ⊣ U) (ag : G ⊣ V) (ah : H ⊣ W)
    (a₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (a₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (a₃ : L₃ ⊣ R₃)
    (δe : V ⋙ U ≅ W) (δs : R₂ ⋙ R₁ ≅ R₃)
    (γ₁ : U ⋙ Gx ⟶ Gy ⋙ R₁) (γ₂ : V ⋙ Gy ⟶ Gz ⋙ R₂)
    (γ₃ : W ⋙ Gx ⟶ Gz ⋙ R₃)
    (ν₁ : F ⋙ Gy ≅ Gx ⋙ L₁) (ν₂ : G ⋙ Gz ≅ Gy ⋙ L₂)
    (ν₃ : H ⋙ Gz ≅ Gx ⋙ L₃)
    (hν₁ : ∀ P M (f : F.obj P ⟶ M), a₁.homEquiv _ _
      (ν₁.inv.app P ≫ Gy.map f) = Gx.map (af.homEquiv _ _ f) ≫ γ₁.app M)
    (hν₂ : ∀ P M (f : G.obj P ⟶ M), a₂.homEquiv _ _
      (ν₂.inv.app P ≫ Gz.map f) = Gy.map (ag.homEquiv _ _ f) ≫ γ₂.app M)
    (hν₃ : ∀ P M (f : H.obj P ⟶ M), a₃.homEquiv _ _
      (ν₃.inv.app P ≫ Gz.map f) = Gx.map (ah.homEquiv _ _ f) ≫ γ₃.app M)
    (hr : ∀ M, Gx.map (δe.hom.app M) ≫ γ₃.app M =
      γ₁.app (V.obj M) ≫ R₁.map (γ₂.app M) ≫ δs.hom.app (Gz.obj M)) (P : X) :
    Gz.map ((((af.comp ag).ofNatIsoRight δe).leftAdjointUniq ah).hom.app P) ≫
      ν₃.hom.app P =
    ν₂.hom.app (F.obj P) ≫ L₂.map (ν₁.hom.app P) ≫
      (((a₁.comp a₂).ofNatIsoRight δs).leftAdjointUniq a₃).hom.app (Gx.obj P)
```

proof.text: Compare inverse isomorphisms, transpose through L3⊣R3, and apply the composite transpose formula. The three evaluation normalization equations express the result in terms of the units of F and G. Naturality of γ1 moves the intermediate G-unit into the first evaluation. The right-square pasting equation inserts δe; adjoint uniqueness identifies the transpose of the inverse extension compositor with the composite unit. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence and equality of inverses prove the assertion.
